note: macOS block re-calibrated 2026-09-12 on the GitHub-hosted macos-14-arm64 runner (run 34700486900, seed protocol count=200 samples=2 workers=2, ~10x slower than local Apple M4, no ANE). source baselines = fresh calibration medians (floor = x0.65). onedir baselines are deliberately LOWER than the solo calibration medians: gate runs execute right after a PyInstaller build on a hot VM and repeatedly measured 35-50% below the idle calibration (NEF onedir: idle 10.02 vs in-gate 4.98-5.80), so onedir floors are anchored to the worst in-gate observations x ~0.9 instead. Both pipelines gate with tolerance 0.65 + one retry (guards.yml). Re-calibrate (perf-calibrate workflow) if the runner image changes materially. The platforms.win32 block calibrates the windows-latest seed gate (count=120, samples=2, workers=4, 2026-08-28, 3 interleaved local runs, median-locked).

win32.note: windows-2025 runner seed protocol (4 seeds replicated count=120, workers=4, samples=2 median). Calibrated 2026-08-28 from runner run 33184724010 (JPG 7.4/7.1, HEIF 0.7/0.7, ARW 6.8/7.2, NEF 5.8/6.4 img/s across 2 samples): the 2-core shared VM is 3-10x slower than the local win32 dev box (HEIF software HEVC suffers most), mirroring the 10x macos-14 vs M4 gap. Baselines = measured median / 0.65 + ~15% headroom; gate runs with tolerance 0.65.
